name: Project Ambient
short_description: Control a local-first, power-aware Mac wallpaper collection from ChatGPT.
long_description: Project Ambient turns a Mac wallpaper library into explainable channels and rules. Use the plugin to inspect the active scene, browse existing channels, switch channels, advance a wallpaper, pause or resume rotation, choose a power policy, and restore recent scenes. Files and media stay on the user's Mac; the plugin exposes no local paths or media bytes.
authentication: Bearer token for the private alpha endpoint; OAuth 2.1 PKCE is required before public directory submission.
review_mode: Set AMBIENT_ADAPTER=demo for deterministic synthetic reviewer data.
data_practices: No media files, thumbnails, local paths, or private tags are sent through MCP.
Tool results contain channel names, scene titles, selection explanations, and bounded control outcomes.
Persistent mutations require explicit confirmation and an idempotency key.
